channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama Farmers Federation endorses John Roberts, Danielle Duggar and Jeff Monroe
item.description: The Alabama Farmers Federation announced its endorsements of John Roberts, Danielle Duggar and Jeff Monroe for key legislative districts last Friday.

item.title: Girls’ Day At The Capitol to take place on December 16
item.description: Rep. Susan DuBose will host more than 100 young women at the Capitol to encourage future generations of women in public service.

item.title: Gov. Ivey introduces a CHOOSE Act family: the Moseleys
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey introduced the Moseley family, who utilized the state's CHOOSE Act education savings account, calling their story exactly what the program supports.

item.title: Gov. Ivey signs executive order to continue strong recruiting for National Guard
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey signed an executive order Friday that revitalized a recruitment program, directing financial incentives for those assisting the Alabama National Guard.

item.title: Rep. Sewell celebrates unveiling of Space Command Headquarters sign in Huntsville
item.description: Delegation members gathered at Redstone Arsenal for the historic unveiling of the U.S. Space Command headquarters sign, solidifying Huntsville’s role as its rightful home.

item.title: Alabama Cannabis Coalition criticizes delays, limited licensing for medical cannabis
item.description: After four years of delays, the state commission finally granted dispensary licenses, but advocates called the limited number an "abysmal excuse for access."

item.title: Former U.S. Sen. Doug Jones holds gubernatorial campaign kickoff
item.description: Jones will likely face off with Tommy Tuberville again in 2026, a rematch from 2020.

item.title: ACHE approves $2.7 billion college budget requests, new programs
item.description: Commissioners approved a nearly 6 percent budget increase, allocated new funding for education programs, and signed off on 10 new university degrees.

item.title: Opinion | MAGA’s hidden assault on pluralism endangers America’s constitutional order
item.description: America’s strength has never come from enforced uniformity, but from a Constitution built to protect freedom for all.

item.title: Opinion | Doug Jones has brought excitement to the governor’s race, but can he win?
item.description: Doug Jones enters the governor's race as an underdog, but Friday's launch proved there's plenty of enthusiasm and maybe a pathway in there too.
